offering_description.value: Designs, markets and sells branded apparel, sleepwear and accessories for babies and young children. Sells to parents through department stores, mass merchants, its own stores, online and international franchise partners, with the products sourced from contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: baby and toddler apparel; children's sleepwear; children's outerwear; children's accessories

customer_segment.value: B2C: parents and families buying clothing for babies and young children; B2B: department stores, mass merchants, specialty and online retailers, and franchise partners

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded children's apparel sold wholesale to retailers and direct to consumers; licensing or royalties: royalties from licensed partners selling Carter's-branded products

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets its own brands, sourcing finished goods from contract manufacturers, sold to retailers and consumers; retailer: operates its own stores and online sales, selling directly to parents

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada and Mexico directly, plus international wholesale and franchised stores in Asia, the Middle East and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: Carter's and OshKosh B'gosh brands, both selling children's apparel to the same parents and retail channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: wholesale sales to large retail accounts; own locations: Carter's and OshKosh retail stores across North America; third-party retail: department stores, mass merchants and specialty retailers; online: company websites and third-party online retailers; partners / resellers: international franchise partners operating stores and wholesale accounts
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; third-party retail; online; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: children's product safety rules such as flammability standards, lead and chemical limits from the US Consumer Product Safety Commission
